title: 実写・自然なオフィス
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: exactly one wide recruitment hero illustration/image for a Japanese call-center recruitment website; aspect ratio about 2.39:1 (1938:811 reference). No lower webpage navigation or buttons, no contact sheet, no multiple variants inside one image.
Reference image: approved call-center illustration, used as subject/context reference. Change the composition and visual style substantially according to this concept; don't just recolor the reference.
Concept: 実写・自然なオフィス.
Art direction: High-quality candid documentary photography in an authentic bright Japanese call center. Three Japanese colleagues in their 20s and 30s wearing professional boom-mic headsets, naturally mid-conversation, one smiling toward a teammate. Soft white daylight, pale blue windows, navy clothing, white desks. No stock-photo handshake or posed group grin. Left 42% bright white wall for bold navy/blue headline.
Color palette: white, cobalt blue, navy, pale sky blue or pale teal. Background edges clean and bright enough for a white website; preserve natural skin colors for photographs. No red, orange or neon accents.
Every human operator must wear a professional communications headset ON THE HEAD with a correctly attached boom microphone near the mouth. Show recognizable telephone/customer-contact work with CRM screens whose interface text is unreadable, desk phone or call-script sheets. No programming/code editor, no music headphones around neck, no unrelated meeting-only scene.
Exact text, readable and carefully spelled: small upper-left "CALL CENTER RECRUIT"; headline in two lines "人と話す仕事を、" / "もっとおもしろく。"; small supporting line "声を届ける仲間を、募集しています。".
If the concept naturally uses role speech bubbles, their ONLY exact labels are "電話対応", "営業", "サポート", "チーム". Do NOT use "エンジニア", "AIプランナー", "コーポレート", "採用情報", the previous AI-future slogan, or invented unreadable Japanese. For photorealistic/editorial concepts, omit bubbles if they would distract; the heading, small English label and subcopy must still appear.
Composition: large clearly legible blue/navy Japanese headline in the LEFT 38%-45%; human scene or themed illustration on RIGHT 55%-62%, never cover faces with text. Do not crop the text or faces. Distinct professional concept, one clean finished image. No price, salary, hiring-condition promises, metrics, certifications, generic lorem ipsum, company logos, watermark, frame, CTA button, or navigation. Anatomically coherent hands and headsets. Output one opaque landscape image.

visual_self_check.headline: Complete and readable; matches exact two lines
visual_self_check.headsets: Three foreground operators and background operators wear boom-mic headsets
visual_self_check.theme: CRM screens and desk phone; clearly call center
visual_self_check.style: Photorealistic documentary office, substantially different from anime and watercolor
